reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "The final result is on the page."
summary:
The check compared against the literal placeholder {{final_result_on_page}} rather than a recorded true or false result. The agent also stopped on the initial hero section instead of vertically reading the feature overview headings required by the objective.
Fix the workflow to scroll through the public feature overview at 320 px, capture the observed result, and pass that actual boolean into the final assertion.
steps: analyze: The final result is on the page.
assert: The final result is on the page.
objective: Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only. Remain on this public site. Stop before sign-in, registration or payment. If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, stop and report it. Never change fixture settings. Use only visible controls. Verify the final result on the page. At 320 CSS pixels, use vertical scrolling to read the public feature overview headings. Verify the feature overview is readable without horizontal scrolling. Do not open signup.
